title: Hearty Harmonious Chinese Capers Xiaolongbao
description: A sour and savory Chinese dish featuring capers and wok-hei, served in a tajine-clay vessel, this xiaolongbao is a show-off dish from the Chaozhou region, dairy-free-friendly and full of flavor. It is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Chinese cuisine.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until it starts to smoke.
Add the ginger and scallions and stir-fry until they are fragrant and slightly charred.
Add the capers and stir-fry for another minute, until they are slightly caramelized.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Add the sauce to the wok and stir-fry for another minute, until the sauce has thickened and the capers are coated.
To assemble the xiaolongbao, lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface and place a small spoonful of the caper mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edge of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal the xiaolongbao.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Steam the xiaolongbao over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, until they are cooked through and slightly puffed.
Serve the xiaolongbao in a tajine-clay vessel, garnished with additional scallions and capers if desired.
